Step 1.2 sets h=2rho^vee=sum h_i and f=sum f_i; in sl_3 this gives [h,e]=e, not 2e. [Etingof §17.2, p.88](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-757-representations-of-lie-groups-fall-2023/mit18_757_f23_lec_full.pdf) uses coefficients c_i satisfying sum c_i a_ij=2. Correct the formulas and reconstruct the principal-triple/slice argument. The carrier remains unchanged pending its prerequisite rebuild.

Unestablished prerequisites include one-dimensional root spaces, explicit sl_2 string classification, algebraicity and Borel status of H exp(ad n^+), unipotent containment in a Borel, and exponential/logarithm compatibility with its unipotent radical. The opened root-decomposition, root-triple, complete-reducibility and Borel-conjugacy statements do not supply these claims. F2 also imports regularity, purity and Cohen–Macaulayness without checking the cited quotient theorem’s parameter hypothesis. Supply these prerequisites and the no-embedded-prime argument. findings.location: Statement (ambient O_R/truncated category); Facts F1 and F3; Proof steps 1.1, 2.2, 3.1 and 6.1
findings.evidence: The family definition supplies additive D_R, not the abelian deformed O_R or truncated category used here. F1 does not construct the truncated inducing module or prove its representing and flag properties. Step 2.2 subtracts projective classes without constructing split inclusions over R and asserts uniqueness from the class; step 3.1 assumes decompositions lift. Nakayama detects an existing isomorphism but does not construct one. Define the ambient categories and truncated projectives, then lift both splitting maps and prove their composite invertible. [Soergel §2.1 Theorem 6, preprint p.10](https://archive.mpim-bonn.mpg.de/3653/1/preprint_1989_46.pdf) uses this split-map method. The repaired base-change proposition helps, but the ambient prerequisite remains missing.

Step 2.2 gives the entire localized P_T two Verma factors, whereas only a selected two-label component has two. Step 2.4 incorrectly concludes W_u v={v} from regularity of v and replaces a return-standard flag by a direct sum, contradicted by rank-one P(-2). The singular jet argument must use the point u with stabilizer H, rather than regular v. Step 7.1 tensors with the coinvariant algebra C while calling it the residue field; this must instead be k=R/m. In rank one the erroneous tensor has dimension four rather than two. Repair these component, stabilizer and specialization arguments before using the central order.

findings.evidence: The argument requires divisor-function-field Verma classification, localization of genuine deformed projectives, freeness of the singular invariant order, and recovery of lattices from height-one localizations. Step 1.2 assumes a deformed wall formula from a supplier stating only the ordinary C-module formula. Thus the polynomial localization identification is assumed before deformed full faithfulness and reduction-of-Hom are proved. Step 1.1 also requires constructed root-component Hom generators. Step 4.1 imports a graded-algebra theorem about the radical and inner grading derivation without proof; Wedderburn–Artin alone does not supply it. Step 6.1 extends to all Weyl types using classification supplied only in type A. Prove the deformed comparison, graded-algebra lemma and general Weyl case. [Garnier §9, Proposition 4.13 and Corollary 4.14](https://www.lamfa.u-picardie.fr/agarnier/talks/soergel_notes.pdf) identifies Hom reduction as a separate required result.
